\brandsection{Logo}
\noindent\fbox{\parbox[c][40mm][c]{\dimexpr\linewidth-2\fboxsep-2\fboxrule\relax}{\centering\Large\color{muted}[ LOGO PLACEHOLDER ]\\[2mm]{\normalsize Add the mark to 00-ASSETS/LOGOS/ and reference it here}}}\par\vspace{7mm}
{\large\bfseries\color{ink}Usage rules}\par\vspace{2mm}
\begin{itemize}
\item Clear space: keep padding equal to the height of the logo mark on every side.
\item Minimum size: 24 px tall on screen, 15 mm tall in print.
\item Use the full-colour mark on light surfaces and the reversed (white) mark on dark or busy backgrounds.
\item Do not stretch, rotate, recolour, add effects to, or crop the mark.
\item Keep the mark clear of competing imagery and maintain strong contrast.
\item Source files live in project-management/src/00-ASSETS/LOGOS/ (SVG source of truth plus raster exports).
\end{itemize}
\clearpage

\brandsection{Voice \& Tone}
{\large\color{ink}Tagline}\par{\LARGE\bfseries\color{accent}A short, memorable statement of what you stand for.}\par\vspace{6mm}
{\large\bfseries\color{ink}Personality}\par\vspace{2mm}
{\large\color{muted}Clear \quad\textbullet\quad Confident \quad\textbullet\quad Human \quad\textbullet\quad Concise}\par\vspace{7mm}
\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{0.48\linewidth}
{\large\bfseries\color{ink}Do}\par\vspace{1mm}\begin{itemize}
\item Write in plain, active language.
\item Lead with the benefit to the reader.
\item Use British English spelling.
\item Keep sentences short and scannable.
\end{itemize}\end{minipage}\hfill\begin{minipage}[t]{0.48\linewidth}
{\large\bfseries\color{ink}Don't}\par\vspace{1mm}\begin{itemize}
\item Use jargon, buzzwords, or acronyms unexplained.
\item Over-promise or lean on hype.
\item Switch tone or register mid-journey.
\item Pad sentences with filler words.
\end{itemize}\end{minipage}
\clearpage

\rowcolor{ink}\textcolor{white}{\textbf{Token}} & \textcolor{white}{\textbf{Value}} & \textcolor{white}{\textbf{Use}} \\
